deletion_condition: Replace only after W12.2 has ingested reviewed source material through the real sharpening machinery and its runtime validator has equivalent coverage; never delete it merely because a prose page exists.

review_state.independence_requirement: Each external reviewer must be independent of the authorship of the dossier they review: no co-authorship of the cited anchors, no supervisory or institutional reporting relationship with the source-preparation author, and no participation in drafting the formulation or variant firewall under review. A reviewer must record which anchors and which category distinctions they personally checked, and must state separately whether they are checking source fidelity or mathematical validity.

reviewer_records.expertise: Documentation-contract implementation and source-anchor hygiene. This is not a mathematical specialty review and is not offered as one.
reviewer_records.independence: Not independent: this reviewer authored the material under review.

unresolved_questions: No field-wide adjudicated status registry was reachable in this pass, so no dossier carries a current-status determination and every one requires a dated refresh immediately before publication.
The SP4D category distinctions and all five primary locators require confirmation by an independent smooth-4-manifold specialist; source-fidelity checking here does not substitute for that.
Each rung-6 dossier needs its own subfield reviewer; whether a single reviewer may cover more than one dossier without losing independence is undecided.
The rung-7 new-theory template has not been exercised against a real submission, so its prediction and consistency requirements are untested in practice.
Whether the bounded SP4D subgoals are the right three, as opposed to a larger set, is a scientific judgement this source pass did not make.
